proj1.title: Lia — AI Hotel Chatbot
proj1.desc: Designed and built Lia, an AI chatbot for inventory management and price negotiation in the hospitality sector. Contributed to 50+ direct bookings for Galle Face Hotel within months of launch. Architected a SQL-based LLM agent that dynamically generates and executes complex queries, cutting generation time by 50% vs the prior MemGPT solution.

proj2.title: Kaya AI Platform — Low-Code Agentic AI
proj2.desc: Implemented core features on the Kaya AI Platform, a low-code solution for building and managing agentic AI systems supporting text and audio-based conversational agents with RAG, graph RAG, MCP, and self-learning integrations. Built the data lineage feature to track and visualise data flow across agent graphs.

proj3.title: Med-QnA — Medical Question Answering System
proj3.desc: AI-powered medical question answering system that provides accurate, context-aware responses to healthcare queries. Built with advanced NLP techniques and fine-tuned language models to handle domain-specific medical terminology.

proj4.title: Fine-tuning LLaMA 7B for Intent Classification
proj4.desc: Led a team of 10 to build and annotate a domain-specific chat dataset over 1.5 months. Applied transfer learning, LoRA, and quantisation to fine-tune LLaMA 7B for 50+ intent classes, achieving 80% accuracy with a lightweight architecture.

proj5.title: Kaya Apex — AI Training Platform
proj5.desc: Designed goal-oriented prompts driving natural avatar behaviour in interactive training sessions. Built an LLM-based evaluation system assessing user performance against predefined criteria. Led optimisation effort that significantly improved platform efficiency.

proj6.title: ReCodeAct Agent — Reasoning + Code Action LLM
proj6.desc: Research project integrating chain-of-thought reasoning with executable code generation as the action layer, enabling error detection and significantly improving agent decision-making reliability over standard text-output agents.

proj7.title: ReviewSpotter — Customer Review Analysis
proj7.desc: Built sentiment analysis pipelines processing 100,000+ customer reviews for the travel and tourism sector. Applied advanced NLP techniques to improve detection accuracy and integrated models with Elasticsearch for efficient large-scale data retrieval and analysis.

proj8.title: Dynamic Subscription Management — Kaya AI Platform
proj8.desc: Designed and built an event-driven integration layer connecting Kafka streams and message queues to agentic workflows. Enabled real-time workflow triggering, live streaming of agent outputs, stateful resumption of interrupted workflows, and a self-learning feedback loop.

proj9.title: Credit Card Fraud Detection With Catboost
proj9.desc: In this project I trained Catboost algorithm for detecting credit card frauds. This problem belongs to a anomaly detection category of machine learning. I had a labeled dataset with 0.01% of fraud rate. Goal was to achieve maximum recall with acceptable precision.

proj10.title: Face Mask Detector
proj10.desc: Created and trained a CNN model to detect whether a person is wearing a mask. Uses haar cascade classifier in OpenCV for face detection and a TensorFlow CNN model for classification. Built both a Python GUI and a browser-based web app using TensorFlow.js and OpenCV.js.

proj11.title: Football Data Analyzer
proj11.desc: Custom Python application for a client to analyze football match performance — sprint distance, heat maps, sprint maps, heart rate data. Converts GPS coordinates to local x,y coordinates using ECEF transformations. Built with PyQt5, NumPy, and XML parsing for .gpx files.

proj12.title: Wizard Chess — Unity 3D Game
proj12.desc: 3D chess game with live piece animations made in Unity, based on the Harry Potter wizard chess. Developed the MiniMax AI algorithm from scratch in C#. Created all 3D models and animations in Blender 3D.

proj13.title: Simple Renderer — C++ OpenGL Library
proj13.desc: Portable C++ library for creating and rendering simple 3D scenes using OpenGL. Features basic lighting with multiple lights, color mapping, materials, GLSL shaders, shadows, and a rich transform system. Avoids long OpenGL initialization codes with a clean scene graph API.

proj14.title: Tower Defence — Unity Game
proj14.desc: 3D tower defense game developed as a freelance project. Players defeat enemy waves by placing turrets, bombs, and other structures. 3 levels with increasing difficulty. Enemy characters use state machine-based AI. All 3D models created in Blender 3D.
